fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

`find/search.py`'s `search()` function already converted curly double quotes (U+201C/U+201D) to straight double quotes before tokenising the query, but did not handle curly/smart single quotes (U+2018/U+2019). Users whose keyboard auto-corrected an apostrophe in a search query (e.g. `n:Yawgmoth’s`) received no results.

## What changed

**`find/search.py` line 24** — Extended the existing replace chain to also normalise U+2018 (left single quotation mark) and U+2019 (right single quotation mark / curly apostrophe) to a straight apostrophe.

**`find/find_test.py`** — Added `test_smart_apostrophe` (functional, mirrors `test_smart_quotes`) that searches with a U+2019 curly apostrophe in the query and asserts the correct card is returned.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit find` — 60 passed, 49 skipped (functional tests require populated cards DB; new test will run in CI)

Fixes #12226
